summary.scope: Staged real consumer + Python + ADB, not production platform queue/Agent deployment

fleetMethod: SSH / standalone Windows staging; actual consumer + Python + ADB, fresh identity/occupancy cache, same-phone slots serialized; no production cloud lease or queue
batchLimits: Four-phone phase showed transport losses of unconfirmed cause; owned tests drained/cancelled, then resumed with at most two phones. No Windows/Agent/ADB/USB/media restart or global recovery by this task.
restorationLimitations: 67 first old attempt did not persist original settings. No temporary timeout residue found on reconnection; later re-test confirmed its new before/after values.

79 first old attempt left temporary 600000 ms after disconnect. Restored persistent device default 300000 ms and read back. First actual original value was not recorded and remains unproven. Later attempts confirmed their own before/after values.
dataLimitations: Counts are latest passed phone-slot records, not cross-account/device deduplicated posts.
Only title/date/status/views/likes/comments from the external works list; no detail-page metrics, stable note ID, or Web database write.
0 notes requires proven list end or valid older-than-window date order.
Not all phones compatible; failures/blocks and busy skips remain distinct.
